STEM = "v184-wave-readout-v1"

def completed_context(root, *, viewed=False):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    seal = read(root / "publication-source-v1.json")
    assert ref(__file__) == seal["publisher"], "Use the sealed publisher"
    for binding in seal["helpers"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == {k: binding[k] for k in ["path", "sha256"]}
    training = terminal(root / "wave-train-result-v1.json")
    scores = terminal(root / "scores-v1.json")
    assert training["status"] == "completed-isolated-readout-one-pass-frozen-V183-EMA"
    assert (
        scores["status"]
        == "completed-two-endpoint-wave-readout-fixed-quality-awaiting-native-viewing"
    )
    binding = ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
    assert training["plan"] == scores["plan"] == binding
    for name in ["training-audit-v1.json", "quality-audit-v1.json"]:
        audit = read(root / name)
        assert audit["status"].startswith("pass-") and audit["plan"] == binding
    assert read(root / "quality-audit-v1.json")["scores"] == ref(root / "scores-v1.json")
    figures = read(root / "figures-v1.json")
    paired = read(root / "paired-comparisons-v1.json")
    assert figures["fixture_only_no_actual_V184_quality"] is False
    assert figures["plan"] == paired["plan"] == binding and figures["scores"] == paired[
        "scores"
    ] == ref(root / "scores-v1.json")
    assert (
        figures["native_figures"] == 60
        and figures["native_triplets"] == 12
        and len(figures["images"]) == 60
    )
    assert sum(item["triplet"] for item in figures["images"]) == 12
    assert all(item["no_resize"] for item in figures["images"]) and len(figures["sheets"]) == 15
    assert sorted(i for sheet in figures["sheets"] for i in sheet["indices"]) == list(range(60))
    assert paired["methods"] == 21 and paired["metric_rows"] == 17262 and paired["contrasts"] == 38
    assert paired["primary_endpoint_contrasts"] == 2 and len(paired["table_cells"]) == 1386
    assert paired["real_references_scored"] is False
    if viewed:
        viewing = read(root / "native-viewing-completion-v1.json")
        assert viewing["figures"] == ref(root / "figures-v1.json") and viewing["indices"] == list(
            range(60)
        )
        assert ref(viewing["journal"]["path"]) == viewing["journal"]
    return plan, training, scores, figures, paired


def record_viewing(root, selected, notes):
    _, _, _, figures, _ = completed_context(root)
    if (
        not selected
        or len(selected) != len(set(selected))
        or not set(selected) <= set(range(15))
        or not notes.strip()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected distinct actual sheets0..14 and actual viewing notes")
    journal = root / "native-viewing-v1.jsonl"
    events = (
        [json.loads(line) for line in journal.read_text().splitlines()] if journal.exists() else []
    )
    seen = {i for event in events for i in event["sheets"]}
    if seen & set(selected):
        raise ValueError("Sheet viewing already recorded")
    for index in selected:
        binding = figures["sheets"][index]["image"]
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    event = {
        "recorded_unix_UTC": time.time(),
        "sheets": selected,
        "detail": "original",
        "notes": notes,
    }
    with journal.open("a") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(event) + "\n")
    events.append(event)
    seen.update(selected)
    if seen == set(range(15)):
        save(
            root / "native-viewing-completion-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "actually-viewed60-native-figures-in15-original-detail-sheets",
                "figures": ref(root / "figures-v1.json"),
                "journal": ref(journal),
                "events": events,
                "indices": list(range(60)),
                "native_figures": 60,
                "native_triplets": 12,
                "no_resize": True,
            },
        )
    print(f"Recorded sheets{selected};viewed{len(seen)}/15")


def export_checkpoints(plan, training, scores):
    import torch
    from phase_wave_training_state import inherited_hash, load_ema
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    directory = Path(plan["artifacts"]) / "exports"
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    checkpoint = training["final_checkpoint"]
    assert ref(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint
    state = torch.load(checkpoint["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    base = torch.load(
        plan["frozen_component"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
    )
    exports = {}
    for endpoint, method in METHODS.items():
        module = factory(plan["module_config"]).eval()
        module.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
        if endpoint == "EMA":
            load_ema(module, state["ema"])
        assert inherited_hash(module) == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
        expected = scores["module_hashes"][method]["before"]
        assert model_hash(module) == expected
        source = REPO / "src/demosaic/late_phase_wave_readout.py"
        path = directory / f"phase-wave-readout-{endpoint}-step1000.pt"
        payload = {
            "component": type(module).__name__,
            "module_config": plan["module_config"],
            "state_dict": module.state_dict(),
            "parent": base["parent"],
            "frozen_component": plan["frozen_component"],
            "sampling_library": plan["sampling_library"],
            "source": ref(source),
            "source_checkpoint": checkpoint,
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "frozen_V183_initializer": plan["initializer"],
            "inherited_network_updates": 1800,
            "inherited_adapter_updates": 900,
            "new_readout_updates": 900,
            "training_plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
        }
        with path.open("xb") as stream:
            torch.save(payload, stream)
        restored = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        fresh = factory(plan["module_config"]).eval()
        fresh.load_state_dict(restored["state_dict"], strict=True)
        assert model_hash(fresh) == expected and len(fresh.state_dict()) == 193
        exports[method] = {
            "export": ref(path),
            "source_checkpoint": checkpoint,
            "state": endpoint,
            "module_hash": expected,
            "component": payload["component"],
            "module_config": plan["module_config"],
            "source": payload["source"],
            "frozen_V183_initializer": plan["initializer"],
            "full_state_tensors": 193,
        }
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    return exports

def linked_copy(source, destination):
    """Publish a second path for a terminal immutable artifact, preserving bytes."""
    source, destination = Path(source), Path(destination)
    assert source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink() and not destination.exists()
    os.link(source, destination)
    assert (
        source.stat().st_ino == destination.stat().st_ino
        and ref(source)["sha256"] == ref(destination)["sha256"]
    )


def publish(root, notes):
    plan, training, scores, figures, paired = completed_context(root, viewed=True)
    if not notes.is_file() or len(notes.read_text()) < 300:
        raise ValueError("Actual human quality notes required")
    for path in [INDEX, REPORT, IMAGES, EVIDENCE, Path(plan["artifacts"]) / "exports"]:
        if path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(path)
    assert all((root / name).is_file() for name in evidence_names())
    assert shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free > (48.5 + 0.065) * 2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > (111.5 + 0.025) * 2**30
    exports = export_checkpoints(plan, training, scores)
    previous_index = REPO / "docs/results/v183-coherent-pair-evidence-final-v1.json"
    previous = read(previous_index)
    viewer_methods = dict(previous["viewer_method_checkpoints"], **exports)
    prior = read(previous["figures"]["path"])
    old_images = {item["original_image"]["path"]: item for item in prior["images"]}
    IMAGES.mkdir()
    EVIDENCE.mkdir()
    images = []
    for item in figures["images"]:
        source = Path(item["image"]["path"])
        destination = IMAGES / source.name
        assert ref(source) == item["image"]
        linked_copy(source, destination)
        record = dict(item, original_image=item["image"], image=ref(destination))
        if not item["triplet"]:
            record["predictions"] = dict(
                old_images[item["source_figure"]["path"]]["predictions"], **item["predictions"]
            )
        images.append(record)
    manifest = IMAGES / "manifest-v1.json"
    save(
        manifest,
        {
            "images": images,
            "method_checkpoints": viewer_methods,
            "source": ref(root / "figures-v1.json"),
            "native_figures": 60,
            "native_triplets": 12,
            "no_resize": True,
            "fixture": False,
            "frozen_component": plan["frozen_component"],
            "frozen_V183_initializer": plan["initializer"],
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    copies = {}
    for name in evidence_names():
        source = root / name
        destination = EVIDENCE / name
        linked_copy(source, destination)
        copies[name] = {"original": ref(source), "public": ref(destination)}
    note_copy = EVIDENCE / "human-quality-notes-v1.md"
    linked_copy(notes, note_copy)
    text = "# Phase-aware wave readout: completed quality\n\n" + notes.read_text().strip()
    text += "\n\n[Exact evidence](results/v184-wave-readout-final-v1.json) · [Native-pixel viewer](images/v184-wave-readout-v1/native-viewer.html).\n\n"
    text += (root / "comparison-tables-v1.md").read_text().rstrip() + "\n\n"
    text += "RMS is camera-RGB DN16; template gain1 means exact constructed amplitude. Both new endpoints use frozen V183 EMA as their primary baseline. Additional training/capacity/freezing change together; this is not a matched total-budget loss comparison. Reused development inputs establish neither blind generalization nor noisy-sky safety. ISO100/AHD/JPEG references are qualitative, not exact GT.\n\n"
    text += "## Native comparisons\n\nAll cells retain160×160 source pixels without resizing. The manifest binds source/ROI, checkpoint/state, noise and display exposure/contrast/anchor. Both protected GFX families/JPEGs/siblings remain excluded from training.\n\n"
    for triplet, title in [
        (False, "Comparison boards"),
        (True, "Noisy, restored and exact constructed GT"),
    ]:
        text += f"### {title}\n\n"
        for item in images:
            if item["triplet"] != triplet:
                continue
            text += f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, exposure{item['exposure']:g}, contrast{item['contrast']:g}.\n\n"
            text += f"![Native comparison](images/{STEM}/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})\n\n"
    text += (
        "[Publication verification](results/v184-wave-readout-publication-verification-v1.json).\n"
    )
    with REPORT.open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(text)
    save(
        INDEX,
        {
            "status": "completed-isolated-readout-audited-actually-viewed-and-two-strict-exports",
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "copies": copies,
            "notes": ref(note_copy),
            "report": ref(REPORT),
            "figures": ref(manifest),
            "checkpoints": exports,
            "viewer_method_checkpoints": viewer_methods,
            "baseline_publication": ref(previous_index),
            "table_cells": 1386,
            "native_figures": 60,
            "native_triplets": 12,
            "publication_source": ref(root / "publication-source-v1.json"),
            "publication_storage": "Public receipt/PNG paths hardlink their closed private artifacts after all owners are terminal. Every path/byte remains; hashes bind both. No redundant receipt/image copies.",
            "execution": {
                "new_training_rows": 1000,
                "new_optimizer_updates": 900,
                "new_training_images": 3600,
                "train_counts": training["counts"],
                "quality_counts": scores["counts"],
                "quality_readout_calls": 1500,
                "V183_EMA_replays": 1644,
                "V169_replays": 1644,
                "ADC_exact": 144,
            },
            "actual_new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_sensor_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": paired["scope"],
        },
    )
    print("Published60nativefigures/1386cells/2strictCPUexports/12viewerMethods;zero new inference")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

"""Verify completed readout exports, evidence, native/browser pixels and guides."""

import argparse
import re
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from publish_phase_wave_trial import (
    IMAGES,
    INDEX,
    METHODS,
    REPO,
    REPORT,
    ROOT,
    VERIFICATION,
    completed_context,
    factory,

    ref,

)


def verify(diary):
    plan, training, scores, _figures, paired = completed_context(ROOT, viewed=True)
    if VERIFICATION.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(VERIFICATION)
    final = read(INDEX)
    assert final["plan"] == ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    for key in ["report", "figures", "notes", "publication_source"]:
        assert ref(final[key]["path"]) == final[key]
    for pair in final["copies"].values():
        for binding in pair.values():
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        a, b = [Path(pair[k]["path"]) for k in ["original", "public"]]
        assert a.read_bytes() == b.read_bytes() and (a.stat().st_dev, a.stat().st_ino) == (
            b.stat().st_dev,
            b.stat().st_ino,
        )
    seal = read(final["publication_source"]["path"])
    assert seal["verifier"] == ref(__file__)
    for binding in seal["helpers"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == {k: binding[k] for k in ["path", "sha256"]}
        if "text" in binding:
            assert Path(binding["path"]).read_text() == binding["text"]
    import torch
    from phase_wave_training_state import inherited_hash, load_ema
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from reduce_phase_wave_trial import tables
    from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    original_call = torch.nn.Module._call_impl

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("No Module forward in final publication verification")

    torch.nn.Module._call_impl = forbidden
    try:
        state = torch.load(
            training["final_checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
        )
        initializer = torch.load(
            plan["initializer"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
        )
        strict = 0
        for endpoint, method in METHODS.items():
            entry = final["checkpoints"][method]
            assert (
                entry["source_checkpoint"] == training["final_checkpoint"]
                and entry["state"] == endpoint
            )
            assert ref(entry["export"]["path"]) == entry["export"]
            exported = torch.load(entry["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            actual = factory(plan["module_config"]).eval()
            actual.load_state_dict(exported["state_dict"], strict=True)
            expected = factory(plan["module_config"]).eval()
            expected.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
            if endpoint == "EMA":
                load_ema(expected, state["ema"])
            assert (
                model_hash(actual)
                == model_hash(expected)
                == entry["module_hash"]
                == scores["module_hashes"][method]["before"]
            )
            assert inherited_hash(actual) == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
            assert all(
                torch.equal(actual.state_dict()[n], v) for n, v in initializer["state_dict"].items()
            )
            assert (
                len(actual.state_dict()) == 193
                and sum(p.numel() for p in actual.parameters() if p.requires_grad) == 316
            )
            assert exported["component"] == type(actual).__name__ == entry["component"]
            assert exported["module_config"] == entry["module_config"] == plan["module_config"]
            assert (
                exported["new_readout_updates"] == 900
                and exported["inherited_network_updates"] == 1800
                and exported["inherited_adapter_updates"] == 900
            )
            assert (
                exported["frozen_V183_initializer"]
                == entry["frozen_V183_initializer"]
                == plan["initializer"]
            )
            assert ref(exported["source"]["path"]) == exported["source"] == entry["source"]
            strict += 1
        text, cells = tables(paired["summary"])
        assert len(cells) == 1386 and cells == paired["table_cells"]
        assert (
            ROOT / "comparison-tables-v1.md"
        ).read_text() == text + "\n" and text in REPORT.read_text()
        manifest = read(final["figures"]["path"])
        assert (
            manifest["fixture"] is False
            and manifest["method_checkpoints"] == final["viewer_method_checkpoints"]
        )
        old_index = read(final["baseline_publication"]["path"])
        assert all(
            manifest["method_checkpoints"][m] == v
            for m, v in old_index["viewer_method_checkpoints"].items()
        )
        assert len(manifest["method_checkpoints"]) == 12
        prior = read(plan["prior_figures"]["path"])
        old_map = {i["image"]["path"]: i for i in prior["images"]}
        new_channels = copied_channels = old_prediction_channels = 0
        assert len(manifest["images"]) == 60 and sum(i["triplet"] for i in manifest["images"]) == 12
        for item in manifest["images"]:
            assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"] and item["no_resize"]
            assert Path(item["image"]["path"]).parent == IMAGES
            assert (
                Path(item["image"]["path"]).read_bytes()
                == Path(item["original_image"]["path"]).read_bytes()
            )
            old = old_map[item["source_figure"]["path"]]
            assert item["source_figure"] == old["image"] == ref(old["image"]["path"])
            assert all(item[k] == old[k] for k in ["ROI_xywh", "anchor", "contrast", "exposure"])
            assert item["case"] == old["case"]
            image = np.asarray(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]).convert("RGB"))
            old_image = np.asarray(Image.open(old["image"]["path"]).convert("RGB"))
            arrays = dict(np.load(item["case"]["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
            anchor = np.asarray(item["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
            old_panels = {p["label"]: p for p in old["panels"]}
            for panel in item["panels"]:
                label = panel["label"]
                x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
                assert w == h == 160
                actual = image[y : y + h, x : x + w]
                if label in METHODS.values():
                    binding = item["predictions"][label]
                    assert (
                        binding == scores["native_predictions"][item["case"]["id"]][label]
                        and ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                    )
                    rgb = np.load(binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)
                    displayed = anchor + item["contrast"] * (rgb.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                        actual,
                        independent_display(displayed, arrays, item["ROI_xywh"], item["exposure"]),
                    )
                    new_channels += actual.size
                else:
                    old_panel = old_panels[label]
                    ox, oy, ow, oh = old_panel["xywh"]
                    assert ow == oh == 160
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, old_image[oy : oy + oh, ox : ox + ow])
                    copied_channels += actual.size
                    if label in item.get("predictions", {}):
                        binding = item["predictions"][label]
                        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                        rgb = np.load(binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)
                        displayed = anchor + item["contrast"] * (rgb.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                            actual,
                            independent_display(
                                displayed, arrays, item["ROI_xywh"], item["exposure"]
                            ),
                        )
                        old_prediction_channels += actual.size
        assert (
            new_channels == 8294400
            and copied_channels == 65510400
            and old_prediction_channels == 36864000
        )
        browser_path = REPO / "docs/results/v184-wave-readout-native-viewer-verification-v1.json"
        browser = read(browser_path)
        assert (
            browser["RGB_channels_exact_source_PNG"] == 36864000
            and browser["browser_crop_screenshots"] == 480
        )
        assert (
            browser["JS_errors"] == [] and browser["fixture_only_no_actual_V184_quality"] is False
        )
        assert (
            browser["viewer"] == ref(IMAGES / "native-viewer.html")
            and browser["manifest"] == final["figures"]
        )
        diary = diary.resolve()
        assert diary.is_relative_to(REPO / "diary") and diary.is_file()
        documents = [
            REPO / p
            for p in [
                "README.md",
                "docs/index.md",
                "docs/current-model.md",
                "docs/research.md",
                "docs/experiments.md",
                "docs/phase-wave-readout.md",
                "docs/phase-evidence-matching.md",
                "docs/phase-wave-readout-comparison.md",
            ]
        ] + [diary]
        links = 0
        for path in documents:
            for target in re.findall(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)", path.read_text()):
                if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):
                    continue
                resolved = (path.parent / target.split("#")[0]).resolve()
                assert resolved == VERIFICATION or resolved.is_file(), (path, target)
                links += 1
        assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
        save(
            VERIFICATION,
            {
                "status": "pass-readout-exports-frozen-inheritance-tables-native-browser-pixels-and-documents",
                "publication": ref(INDEX),
                "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
                "exact_linked_receipt_copies": len(final["copies"]),
                "strict_CPU_export_loads": strict,
                "inherited_tensor_comparisons": 378,
                "table_cells": 1386,
                "native_figures": 60,
                "native_triplets": 12,
                "new_native_RGB_channels_recomputed": new_channels,
                "unchanged_native_RGB_channels_compared": copied_channels,
                "old_ten_prediction_channels_also_recomputed": old_prediction_channels,
                "browser_RGB_channels_exact": 36864000,
                "document_links": links,
                "documents": {str(p): ref(p) for p in documents},
                "new_module_forwards": 0,

"""Check actual raw/EMA matched browser captures against their public PNG pixels."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from phase_admission_protocol import read, ref
from PIL import Image
from train_phase_wave_trial import REPO, save

METHODS = {
    "control": {e: "V183-coherent-pair-EMA" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]},
    "evidence": {e: f"V184-wave-readout-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]},
}


def verify(directory, output):
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output)
    browser = read(directory / "browser-records-v1.json")
    assert browser["fixture_only_no_V184_quality"] is False and browser["JS_errors"] == []
    assert len(browser["records"]) == 480 and len(browser["metadata"]) == 96
    viewer = Path(browser["viewer"])
    manifest_path = viewer.with_name("manifest-v1.json")
    manifest = read(manifest_path)
    assert manifest["fixture"] is False and manifest["native_figures"] == 60
    expected_old = read(REPO / "docs/results/v183-coherent-pair-evidence-final-v1.json")[
        "viewer_method_checkpoints"
    ]
    assert set(manifest["method_checkpoints"]) == set(expected_old) | set(
        METHODS["evidence"].values()
    )
    for method, entry in expected_old.items():
        assert manifest["method_checkpoints"][method] == entry
    for entry in manifest["method_checkpoints"].values():
        assert ref(entry["source_checkpoint"]["path"]) == entry["source_checkpoint"]
    images = {item["image"]["path"]: item for item in manifest["images"] if not item["triplet"]}
    assert len(images) == 48
    for item in images.values():
        assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"]
    assert len({(m["case"], m["endpoint"]) for m in browser["metadata"]}) == 96
    for record in browser["metadata"]:
        for arm in ["control", "evidence"]:
            method = METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
            metadata = manifest["method_checkpoints"][method]
            assert metadata["state"] == ("EMA" if arm == "control" else record["endpoint"])
            for value in [method, metadata["source_checkpoint"]["sha256"], metadata["module_hash"]]:
                assert value in record["description"]
    channels = 0
    assert len({(r["case"], r["endpoint"], r["id"]) for r in browser["records"]}) == 480
    for record in browser["records"]:
        rect = record["rect"]
        assert rect["width"] == rect["height"] == 160
        assert rect["x"].is_integer() and rect["y"].is_integer()
        item = images[record["source"]]
        expected_panel = next(p for p in item["panels"] if p["label"] == record["label"])
        assert expected_panel["xywh"] == record["panel"]
        if record["id"] in ["a", "b"]:
            arm = "control" if record["id"] == "a" else "evidence"
            assert record["label"] == METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
        x, y, width, height = record["panel"]
        assert width == height == 160
        expected = np.asarray(Image.open(record["source"]).convert("RGB"))[
            y : y + height, x : x + width
        ]
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(record["screenshot"]).convert("RGB"))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
        channels += actual.size
    assert channels == 36864000
    save(
        output,
        {
            "status": "pass-actual-matched-browser-480-native-crops-checkpoint-state-and-source-pixels",
            "viewer": ref(viewer),
            "manifest": ref(manifest_path),
            "browser_records": ref(directory / "browser-records-v1.json"),
            "browser_version": browser["browser"],
            "cases": 48,
            "matched_raw_EMA_pairs": 96,
            "browser_crop_screenshots": 480,
            "RGB_channels_exact_source_PNG": channels,
            "rectangle_width_height": [160, 160],
            "per_method_state_metadata_checked": True,
            "default_V183_EMA_vs_V184_EMA": True,
            "click_keyboard_flip_and_navigation": True,
            "JS_errors": [],
            "screenshot_bindings": [ref(r["screenshot"]) for r in browser["records"]],
            "fixture_only_no_actual_V184_quality": False,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
            "scope": "Actual headless-browser screenshot pixels and source/checkpoint-state metadata are checked. Image-quality gains and costs require the separate matched measurements and actual human native viewing.",
        },
    )
    print("PASS480actualbrowsercrops/36864000RGBchannels/raw+EMAstate-metadata")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify(args.directory.resolve(), args.output.resolve())
